mapper.select: select T1.FINPROD_ID from FIN_PRODUCT T1 where T1.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodType2} AND T1.TRADE_MARKET in(#{TRADE_PLACE_01},#{TRADE_PLACE_02}) AND T1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID=#{finprodMarketId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND ROWNUM=1

select t.O_TYPE as oType, t.SHORT_LONG_TERM as shortLongTerm, t.GRADE_DATE as gradeDate, t.RATING as gradeResult, MCI.CUSTOMER_NAME as gradeOrg from ( SELECT ASSET_CODE,RATING,GRADE_ORG_ID,SHORT_LONG_TERM,O_TYPE,GRADE_DATE FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY BRATING.O_CODE ORDER BY BRATING.O_CODE,BRATING.GRADE_DATE DESC ,BRATING.GRADE_RESULT DESC) RANK,BRATING.O_CODE AS ASSET_CODE,BRATING.GRADE_RESULT AS RATING, BRATING.GRADE_ORG_ID as GRADE_ORG_ID,BRATING.SHORT_LONG_TERM as SHORT_LONG_TERM, BRATING.O_TYPE as O_TYPE,BRATING.GRADE_DATE as GRADE_DATE FROM MST_BOND_CREDIT_RATING BRATING WHERE BRATING.O_TYPE = '01' AND BRATING.GRADE_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{platformDate},'YYYY-MM-DD') ) WHERE RANK=1 union all SELECT ASSET_CODE,RATING,GRADE_ORG_ID,SHORT_LONG_TERM,O_TYPE,GRADE_DATE FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY BRATING.O_CODE ORDER BY BRATING.O_CODE,BRATING.GRADE_DATE DESC ,BRATING.GRADE_RESULT DESC ) RANK ,BRATING.O_CODE AS ASSET_CODE ,BRATING.GRADE_RESULT AS RATING, BRATING.GRADE_ORG_ID as GRADE_ORG_ID,BRATING.SHORT_LONG_TERM as SHORT_LONG_TERM, BRATING.O_TYPE as O_TYPE,BRATING.GRADE_DATE as GRADE_DATE FROM MST_BOND_CREDIT_RATING BRATING WHERE BRATING.O_TYPE = '02' AND BRATING.GRADE_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{platformDate},'YYYY-MM-DD') ) WHERE RANK=1 ) t LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO MCI ON MCI.CUSTOMER_ID=t.GRADE_ORG_ID where t.ASSET_CODE=#{finprodMarketId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
select count(1) as qty from TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL where FINPROD_ID=#{finprodId} and IS_CANCEL ='N'

SELECT T1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID id, T1.FINPROD_ABBR text, T1.FINPROD_NAME, T1.FINPROD_ID, T1.CALENDAR_ID, T1.TRADE_MARKET, T1.IS_RIGHT, T2.TYPE_9, T2.TYPE_10, T2.TYPE_11, to_char(T1.VDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') VDATE, to_char(T1.MDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') MDATE, T1.CCY FROM FIN_PRODUCT T1 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE T2 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID
AND T1.VDATE <= #{platDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND T1.MDATE >= #{platDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND T1.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodType2} AND T1.TRADE_MARKET in(#{TRADE_PLACE_01},#{TRADE_PLACE_02})
and T1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{initValue}
and (T1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')) or T1.FINPROD_NAME like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')) or T1.FINPROD_ABBR like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')) or T1.FINPROD_ID like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')) )

select t.* from ( SELECT case when PRODUCT.CIRCULATION_CODE is not null then PRODUCT2.FINPROD_MARKET_ID else PRODUCT_ADD.APPEAR_MARKET_ID end as id, case when PRODUCT.CIRCULATION_CODE is not null then PRODUCT2.FINPROD_ABBR else PRODUCT.FINPROD_ABBR end as text, PRODUCT.TRADE_MARKET, PRODUCT.VDATE, PRODUCT.MDATE, PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2 FROM FIN_PRODUCT PRODUCT LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD PRODUCT_ADD ON PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = PRODUCT_ADD.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT PRODUCT2 ON PRODUCT.CIRCULATION_CODE = PRODUCT2.FINPROD_ID ) t
AND t.VDATE <= #{platDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND t.MDATE >= #{platDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND t.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodType2} AND t.TRADE_MARKET in(#{TRADE_PLACE_01},#{TRADE_PLACE_02})
and t.id = #{initValue}
and (t.id like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')) or t.text like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')) )
union select t.secid as id, t.SECNAME as text, t.MARKET2 as TRADE_MARKET, t.VDATE, t.MDATE, null as FINPROD_TYPE2 from INTERF_PAYHSRCSECINFO t
AND t.VDATE <= #{platDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND t.MDATE >= #{platDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND t.MARKET2 in(#{TRADE_PLACE_01},#{TRADE_PLACE_02})
and t.secid = #{initValue}
and (t.secid like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')) or t.SECNAME like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')) )
select T.TOTLE_TRADE_ID from TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T inner join TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_BARTER_TOTAL B on T.TOTLE_TRADE_ID=B.TRADE_ID ||'R' where T.FINPROD_ID=#{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and rownum=1
